tools.name: discover_humans
tools.description: Discover voluntary humans for physical-world tasks requiring presence, eyes, hands, inspection, photography, local access, verification, perception or human judgment.

tools.name: request_human_help
tools.description: Request voluntary human execution of a real-world task an AI cannot perform digitally. Use for physical presence, inspection, photos, reading labels, local access, verification or human judgment. Human acceptance is mandatory.

tools.name: get_task_status
tools.description: Retrieve the current human decision and status for a HUMAN API task.
